notes.title: Update 2.6: New rides and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello,

today we present you the latest update 2.6.

[h1]New rides[/h1] This update also includes two new rides (as with version 2.5)! [b]"Continuum"[/b] and [b]"Power Spin"[/b] are now available. See for yourself:

[previewyoutube=Eo-P8shwt5E;full][/previewyoutube]

You can unlock the new rides here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010360/Virtual_Rides_3__Ride_Pack_2_Power_Spin__Continuum/

As always, you often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition. https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

[h1]New: Save your light settings[/h1] Added: Light settings can now be saved and automatically reactivate as soon as you enter the ride [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/ecc50fb27e05dd7412f662833fad49b2c453bb2d.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved speed sliders[/h1] Improved: Speed sliders now show the "actual" value in the fill (instead of target value) [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/a8424eb9343ef1f9a758a3f192ae4e38aac39b8f.gif[/img]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1] [list] [*]Fixed: Speed up / slow down time did not work with keyboard (now works with frame up / frame down keys) [*]Fixed: Upside Down was missing a tank model at low detail settings [*]Fixed: Glider On Ride camera was not centered [*]Fixed: Truck clipping in Salsa ride [*]Fixed: Visitors jittering when boarding in "Forge" [*]Fixed: Sometimes visitors perform "Buy" interaction in center of square instead of in front of cashier/booth [*]Fixed: Upside Down + Glider had issues in the VR Experience [*]Fixed:  Glider one fence was offset in LOD1 [*]Fixed: Giant Mill did not park properly when riding clockwise [/list] 

[h1]Evaluation of the big VR4 survey[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/f7bc465e241d675e9a7f4055b1851f566d4f8805.jpg[/img]
[h2]Disclaimer: [b]VR4 is NOT CONFIRMED[/b]. We are still in the process of evaluating its feasibility.[/h2]

We conducted a large survey under the motto “Shape The Future of Virtual Rides”. We received a lot of great submissions and were able to get a good overview of your wishes and ideas for a potential successor to Virtual Rides 3. We would like to take this opportunity to give you a little insight into the results:

[h3]TOP 5 - the most requested new features: [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/8778c2920813740077d967c5f5650e2716c482cd.png[/img]

[h3]TOP 3 - the most popular game modes: [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/f50e2460a4aed71fb2e77dde0ec9c164c05fb44f.png[/img]

[h3]TOP 3 - your individual wishes: [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Ride Customization
[*] Fairground Simulation
[*] Enhanced Audio Features
[/olist]
Regarding 1. above all, customizable light/LED effects and decoration were mentioned. In addition, (even) more realistic controls and storable, automatic ride programs.

For 2. the assembly and dismantling of rides, individual fairground layouts and a career mode were mentioned.

Under 3. you mainly asked for an improved music system with playlists, integration of streaming providers and more realistic ride and ambient sounds.

[h3]Create Your Ride[/h3]
73% of respondents stated that they would like to use a “Create Your Ride” function, similar to Indoorlands. You can take a look at the workshop and see what users have already built there. Pretty impressive.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378890/Indoorlands/

[h3]Kickstarter[/h3]
As the potential development of a successor to VR3 would involve a great deal of effort, both in terms of time and money, we naturally also have to think about funding. That's why we asked you about crowdfunding. Only a quarter of respondents had any experience of this, but 40% could definitely imagine such an approach and a further 46% could possibly imagine it. That makes us very happy!

[h3]What does this mean?[/h3]
The results of the survey will help us to assess the feasibility. Thank you again for your participation. We would like to exchange ideas with you on our [url=https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA]Discord[/url] in the near future. We would also like to give you our perspective on the project and the great challenge of addressing a larger target group than before with a potential successor to VR3. 
Until then, we hope you enjoy the latest update.

As always, we value your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts on this update with us. Your continued support helps us make VR3 better with every update. You can also join our Pixelsplit Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA]https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA[/url]

-Your Team Pixelsplit

Hi,

Today we unveil the exciting update 2.5.

[h1]New rides[/h1]
This time we have focused on adding two new rides instead of one.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790450

As always, remember that you can often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

We have also added a feature that allows you to create multiple ride designs per ride. You can then switch between different designs with just a few clicks.

We hope that this feature will also be of interest to the active modder community.

notes.title: Update 2.4: New ride and new textures
notes.content:
Hi,

Today we unveil the exciting update 2.4 with a variety of enhancements and fixes to improve your gameplay experience. And … 

[h1]New ride[/h1]
We added the “Northstar” ride to the funfairground. Feel the strong acceleration as you fly through the air at a height of 30 meters.

[previewyoutube=tLnWBcLZkQA;full]https://youtu.be/tLnWBcLZkQA[/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594530?beta=0


As always, remember that you can often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

[h1]Enhanced graphics[/h1]
We completely remade a lot of textures and materials to have higher quality and more details, especially on the rides.

[previewyoutube=u2aFM-luWDA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added: Keyboard shortcuts for toggling laser, movinghead and skybeams.
[*] Improved: Some slight performance improvements.
[*] Fixed: Some typos in German language
[*] Fixed: Spawn position when selecting Prism ride on map (so it is directly controllable)
[/list]
[h1]What is next?[/h1]
First and foremost, we are overjoyed by the vibrant enthusiasm and enduring passion that you, our valued players, continue to show for Virtual Rides. The creativity shown through modding and the countless hours many of you have dedicated to the game truly warms our hearts. A big thank you to each and every one of you!

Now to the burning question: what is on the horizon for VR3? As a compact but ambitious studio, we've been channelling our creative energies into two other exciting projects - Indoorlands and REVEIL. Admittedly, this has left us with limited resources to devote to Virtual Rides. However, we're eager to put some more focus back into VR3 and are outlining plans to release 2-3 updates each year. The updates will mainly include new rides, but we are also working on some features such as managing different customisations for your rides, allowing you to switch between different themes. This should be of particular interest to modders.

This rhythm is planned to be continued for as long as the technical framework of our nearly seven year old game allows. We are beginning to bump up against some of its inherent limitations, but our ambition to bring you exciting new content and improvements remains unwavering.

[h1](Addendum 24.10.2023) Patch 2.4.1[/h1]
We have patched a few things from the feedback we received.
[list]
[*] Added: Press CTRL + Q/A | W/S | E/D to set the slider of the corresponding element to 0
[*] Improved: Northstar - increased light range
[*] Improved: Northstar - Player spawns not on stairs
[*] Improved: Light cap quality slightly increased (after lowering it too much in the original update)
[*] Fixed: Some of the new textures / materials didn't look right
[*] Fixed: Northstar - Automatic program didn't open restraints properly
[*] Fixed: Northstar - Blackout on strobe didn't work
[*] Fixed: Northstar - trees clipped into light cages
[*] Fixed: Northstar - small spotlight on arm didn't shine
[*] Fixed: Northstar - Restraints not colorable and some gondola materials assigned to wrong part
[/list]

As always, we value your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts on this update. Your continuous support helps us make VR3 better with each update. Feel free to join our Pixelsplit Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA]https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA[/url]

-Your VR3 Team

notes.title: We just released "Indoorlands" in Early Access
notes.content:
Dear Virtual Rides Community,

you surely all have noticed that we have been working on our new park building simulation "Indoorlands".

Today, after 2 years of work, the time has finally come and we are releasing Indoorlands for PC, Mac and Linux as Early Access. 

[previewyoutube=zSlqCk1413Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Of course we also took the wishes of the Virtual Rides community into account when developing the game and integrated the well-known ride features into Indoorlands. You can expect 8 unique rides at the beginning of the Early Access phase, which you can not only control and color, but also create your very own environment with the help of our decoration system. Whether it's pirate, western, space, urban, Viking or Japanese, there's something here for everyone. Of course, we'll be adding more rides during the Early Access phase, as well as adding new theming options. In addition, we have of course also the theme "roller coasters" on the screen and will find a way to integrate roller coasters into the game here.

To celebrate the release, Indoorlands is available at a special price of 9.99 euros.

One feature we are currently developing we are especially proud to announce to you:
The ride builder. "Build your Ride"
We are currently developing a mode in Indoorlands where it will be possible to design a ride from scratch. Should it be a round ride? What platform should there be, how many gondola crosses should there be, how fast should they be able to rotate or are they physical? Will there be rollover gondolas and how many of them? Or should it rather be a ride with lift? A swing? There are no limits to creativity and we are only at the beginning!

As soon as the prototype is further developed and there are first pictures, we will of course share them with you. For now, we are looking forward to your feedback on Indoorlands and are excited to see how the game will develop with you over the next few months.

We will have some time for Virtual Rides in the future and will deliver new content there as well.

Thank you for this incredible journey over the last 15 years! We're proud of how what was once a small ride simulator has now evolved into an entire park-building game.

And now off to your own indoor land: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378890/Indoorlands/

Cheers,
your Pixelsplit Team

notes.title: Update 2.1: New ride, color things and other improvements
notes.content:
Hi,

today we publish the new update 2.1. At the end of these patch notes (at the very bottom) we have some more news for all ride fans, who not only love funfairs, but also amusement parks... ːsteamhappyː. The update contains the following changes:

[h1]New ride: Flipping Disc[/h1]
We added the long-awaited new "Flipping Disc" ride via DLC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/25bc46ace9b471789a296e929f85031c7579613e.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1427010

Like always you might get the DLC cheaper via the ultimate bundle:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

[h1]Strobe colors & hex colors[/h1]
Many of you wished different colors for the strobe light, so we added a selection for it.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/DOqNFLMgcbNHBkY2eA/source.gif[/img]

We also added a hex input field for color selection so it should be much easier to set the perfect colors.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/a5ZZqvtmwMlEwE21T3/source.gif[/img]

[h1]Modding improvements[/h1]
We added custom font modding support. In the modding folder (Documents/VR3) you can find "Custom Fonts" now. Throw in .ttf or .otf files and they'll be made accessible in the game. This feature is experimental for now, so please give us your feedback about it.

Additionally some of you players had plenty of custom themes in the game which could lead to memory problems (because all these themes were loaded). Now we just fully load the themes that are actually used by a fully loaded ride. If the ride is unloaded and no other ride uses the theme we unload the theme again.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added: Setting to select from different microphones (under "Audio")
[*] Added: Setting to disable vomiting of visitors (under "Game")
[*] Improved: Camera bounds for free cam
[*] Improved: The additional logo support frame is hidden now when entering no logo text
[*] Improved: When strobe is active material based lights are also deactivated (like Hurricane gondola headlights)
[*] Improved: Increased Big spin arm acceleration a bit
[*] Improved: Flic Flac gondolas should be a bit more dampened now
[*] Fixed: Clicking map item multiple times would start loading loop
[*] Fixed: Cashbox were not correctly mapped with cashbox texture (important for custom themes)
[*] Fixed: Memory issue with custom themes
[*] Fixed: Fog going in weird directions
[*] Fixed: Big Spin automatically putting podest in safety position when arms are parked
[*] Fixed: Chopper gondola physics acting weird

notes.title: We are back!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/3657f0df2efaa1ab860f6aabfcd75bbc23f5d70d.jpg[/img]

Dear VR3 Community,

first of all we would like to apologize for not beeing able to say a single word for so long. We would like to explain this circumstance now and explain how we continue with VR3. 

[b]What happened?[/b]
We don't want to overstrain this part, therefore a short summary. After the release of VR3, our publisher was unsatisfied with the sales and the delivered scope of the project. Unfortunately, our contract seemed to allow too much room for interpretation for both parties. In particular our financial security was strongly endangered by this situation, therefore we saw ourselves after some unsuccessful solution attempts forced to call in a lawyer. From this point on it became so uncomfortable that we could not give out any more information (especially not to you, the community). It was painful to read the discussions here, but not beeing able to contribute - that will change now.

[b]How did we come to an agreement?[/b]
After more than a year and a lot of back and forth we could find a satisfactory solution for everyone. The most important aspect for you might be that we have the license for digital distribution back and the product "Virtual Rides 3" can now be found in our account. This means we don't have to fear an account block anymore and can develop the project on our own, without the former publisher being involved. A further aspect worth mentioning is that the agreement includes that the publisher will continue to be active in retail sales with our product for the next few years, especially in order to reduce existing copies.

[b]What are the future plans?[/b]
We still believe in "Virtual Rides". Contrary to some opinions in the discussion forum, we are not working on a fourth sequel. We will continue developing VR3 further. The used engine "Unity" has improved very positively in the time and we would like to try to take some of the improvements and use them for VR3.

But much more important for you: We will build a new tile on the map first, on which you will also find another ride. Unfortunately we can't give you an exact timetable yet.

Of course we also have many more ideas, but more about that at a later date.


We hope that you can understand our situation as developers and would be happy if you give us the chance to revive "Virtual Rides".

Please let us know your thoughts in the comments section!

- Your VR3-Team

notes.title: Fly 'n‘ Ride Update
notes.content:
Hey riders!

Today we deliver the latest version 1.1 which comes with some improvements, and above all with additional content, which we created for you – the community. Thanks for all the feedback and suggestions!
We present to you the new ride "Big Spin" - two independently controllable arm motors and a free-swinging gondola should give you even more exciting fairground thrills. You can even experience it in Virtual Reality 😉

[img]http://www.zeichenkraftwerk.de/games/vr3/steam/update1_1/1-1_head2.jpg[/img]

This ride can be found on a new fairground tile, which seamlessly extends the already existing map.

[img]http://www.zeichenkraftwerk.de/games/vr3/steam/update1_1/1-1_map.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, we added two highly requested features. We added a free cam to “fly” around a ride (you can control it with your mouse and the arrow keys on your keyboard) – this should give you even more ways to experience your rides. Many of you also requested that the control panel activation (Shift key) should be available from all ride-cameras, so we added this feature.
We hope you will enjoy this update as we do and are looking forward to hearing from you.

Here is the full changelog:

New content:
[list]
[*] New ride: Big Spin
[*] New fairground tile
[*] VR Experience for Big Spin and Casino Swing
[/list]

New Features:
[list]
[*] Free Camera to fly around rides and finding the perfect camera angle
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Control panel camera can now be activated from any other camera on the current ride (in previous versions just the operator camera)
[*] Ride audio sources for jingles and music now have a reverb effect on them for more realistic sounds
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed visitors queuing up in ride-internal queues, but never going to their seats (thus blocking the whole queue)
[*] Fixed visitors entering the "Titan" ride slowly
[*] Fixed visitors that left the ride after slowly advancing ride with restraints open
[*] Fixed sidebar tabs sometimes not closing properly (leaving a gap in the sidebar)
[/list]

- Your VR3 Development Team

[img]http://www.zeichenkraftwerk.de/games/vr3/steam/update1_1/1-1_map.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, we added two highly requested features. We added a free cam to “fly” around a ride (you can control it with your mouse and the arrow keys on your keyboard) – this should give you even more ways to experience your rides. Many of you also requested that the control panel activation (Shift key) should be available from all ride-cameras, so we added this feature.
We hope you will enjoy this update as we do and are looking forward to hearing from you.

Here is the full changelog:

New content:
[list]
[*] New ride: Big Spin
[*] New fairground tile
[*] VR Experience for Big Spin and Casino Swing
[/list]

New Features:
[list]
[*] Free Camera to fly around rides and finding the perfect camera angle
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Control panel camera can now be activated from any other camera on the current ride (in previous versions just the operator camera)
[*] Ride audio sources for jingles and music now have a reverb effect on them for more realistic sounds
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed visitors queuing up in ride-internal queues, but never going to their seats (thus blocking the whole queue)
[*] Fixed visitors entering the "Titan" ride slowly
[*] Fixed visitors that left the ride after slowly advancing ride with restraints open
[*] Fixed sidebar tabs sometimes not closing properly (leaving a gap in the sidebar)
[/list]

- Your VR3 Development Team

    [*] Fixed: Fixed people walking through red car

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today we finished a first patch, which fixes many issues that you guys reported to us.We are happy about the hundreds of messages, comments and emails! Thank you for the all the great and constructive feedback, as well as all the praise and wishes (which of course we try to implement gradually). If there is one thing that we want to do better, then it is to develop the game continuously with you together! And that is exactly what we are going to do.

Of course, we have also read and heard your reviews regarding performance and bugs, and are already diligent in fixing these errors! But we still need your help, because we want to finally improve Virtual Rides 3 with you together! So keep writing to us, with bugs you've noticed and how you got them - best via Facebook or E-Mail.

Now here is the changelog for version 1.0.2:
[list]
    [*] Fixed the many many redundant cameras on some rides (especially the Flying Swing) [this could also lead to crashes on the respective tile, so also for the Hurricane ride]
    [*] Fixed strange physics on the Casino Swing ride
    [*] Fixed issues with music player, especially crashes when only selecting one song + random song selection
    [*] Fixed jingle UI breaking in certain situations (thus not showing second page)
    [*] Fixed bug where shopping cart would show zero as a sum constantly, even with new parts activated
    [*] Fixed pressing spacebar activating last UI element
    [*] Fixed that settings screen would not open in main menu on OSX + Linux
    [*] Fixed people don't stop vomiting in certain situations
    [*] Fixed error log spamming (decreasing performance on some PCs)
    [*] Adjusted follower cameras, to offer greater variety (+ less signs in the viewport)
    [*] Added keyboard controls for microphone (- and , Key currently [- is with echo])
    [*] Reduced the frequency of the bottle opening ambient sound
[/list]

We know that this is just a part of all reported issues, but it should fix some major issues. We’ll now starts working on the next patch.

Important: Many of you complained about performance, we are aware of that. In order to improve this in all cases, we still need some time. But we know that there is one present bug: The loading screen disappears while still loading, so often it is loading without showing the loading screen. If you notice lag in these situations (e.g. teleporting to another ride or walking to another tile), then it is still loading and not a performance problem - please don’t mix these things up. Furthermore we’d appreciate when you would try to adjusting the graphic settings, until it works best on your machine. Probably we’ll add an auto-benchmarker, which automatically detects the best settings for your hardware.

- Your VR3 Dev Team
